title: Bump golang.org/x/crypto to v0.52.0
no_spec_change_rationale: The Go module still uses ChaCha20-Poly1305, Curve25519, and HKDF from golang.org/x/crypto. This version bump does not change the public API or the protocol.
acceptance_criteria: go.mod requires golang.org/x/crypto v0.52.0, go test passes, and the Go sources still import only chacha20poly1305, curve25519, and hkdf.
